week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required

CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  September 11, 2019
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLL CALL
  Chair MacCarley called the meeting to order at 5:08 pm.

  Present: Ghazarian, Devine, Abkarian, Chair MacCarley.
  Absent: Manoukian.

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of July 10, 2019.

  Motion: Devine  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Ghazarian, Devine, Chair MacCarley
  Abstained: Abkarian
  Absent: Manoukian

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  None

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Eligible lists Established.

6.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL- UTILITY BUSINESS SYSTEMS SUPPORT ADMINISTRATOR
  (PETROSYAN)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Utility Business Systems Support Administrator as submitted.

  The class specification for Utility Business Systems Support Administrator was approved as submitted by the
  following vote:

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

7.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL- LIBRARIAN SERIES (NAVARRO)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Librarian Series as submitted.

  The class specification for Librarian Series was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Devine  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

8.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL- SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Senior Project Manager as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Senior Project Manager was approved as submitted by the following vote:
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of September 11, 2019
  Page 2 of 2

  Motion: Devine  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

9.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION - REPORT ON UNCLASSIFIED STATUS PROPOSAL FOR COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT/ HOUSING SECTION ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT POSITION (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Adoption of Resolution.

  The Resolution for the Unclassified Status Proposal for Community Development Department/ Housing
  Section Administrative Assistant Position was adopted as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Devine  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

10.  REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a)  Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations Report.

11.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  Mr. Doyle congratulated Commissioner Abkarian on his recent reappointment to the Civil Service
  Commission. Commissioner Abkarian thanked Mr. Doyle for his comments and requested a report from staff
  that would illustrate how candidates are rated and ranked via an internal panel. Mr. Doyle noted that he will
  prepare a report for the November meeting that will address the formation of oral panels and how
  candidates get evaluated by the panel members. The Commissioners noted the importance of September
  11th. Commissioner Ghazarian stated that though cruelty to mankind stands alone over the course of history,
  day in and day out there are many injustices that take place that public servants, whether they be members
  of the Police Department, Fire Department, or just individuals who serve in public service, give themselves to
  this cause so that we may live the lives that we live. He continued to say that he is thankful to those in the
  City of Glendale in all departments; there are public servants that do things every day and their work goes
  unnoticed. He stated that it is hard to explain to those who were not yet born at the time of the September
  11th tragedy, exactly what that day meant and it makes him pause and contemplate what other great
  catastrophic events must have been like, such as Pearl Harbor and the Armenian Genocide. He felt that it is
  imperative that on this day, we take time to talk to someone who did not experience this event and educate
  them regarding how horrific that day was, but also take the time to thank the individuals who are doing their
  part to provide you with the opportunity to enjoy that great gift of life, liberty, and pursuit of happiness that
  is called America.

12.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 5:41 pm.
